name: Jefferson Lab — Newport News campus
notes: Release pass (2026-10-25): accelerator:cebaf is drawn. The City of Newport News publishes building footprints in which the Jefferson Lab buildings carry the lab's own building numbers (BLDGNOTE 'Jefferson Lab #101' ...), the same numbers as the list on JLab's site plan; OSM has no tunnel, hall or service-building outline for the lab (re-checked 2026-10-25 through the OSM API: 5786 ways in the box, none of them CEBAF).

The tunnel straights are the footprints of building 999 (parts 01 and 02), 265 m long; the two arcs are semicircles of 80.3 m radius fitted to the eight arc service buildings (E2-E5, W2-W5), which lie on them to within 0.6 m (W2 4.4 m). See geometry:jlab-cebaf-racetrack for the derivation and the -6.9% difference from the official 'about 7/8 of a mile'.
Site coordinate: site:jlab-newport-news (campus point 37.09896, -76.48157) is 470 m north of the racetrack centre; it is a campus-grade point and was not used as an anchor for anything.

summary.plain: Jefferson Lab's campus in Newport News, Virginia, drawn to scale: the oval underground tunnel of the CEBAF electron accelerator with its two straight sections and two semicircular arcs, the four experimental halls (A to D), the service buildings that stand on the arcs and the other lab buildings. The tunnel outline is derived from the numbered buildings above it, not traced from a map of the tunnel.
summary.technical: Local map for facility:jefferson-lab. Building footprints from the City of Newport News open-data layer (lab building numbers match JLab's site plan): halls A-D (Hall A verified by a span check against the official '174 feet across'), the two 265 m building-999 strips, eleven arc/extractor/injector service buildings and 70 further buildings. geometry:jlab-cebaf-racetrack is a derived centre line: straights along the strips' axes (160.7 m apart), semicircles of 80.3 m radius fitted to the eight arc service buildings, total 1311 m against the official 'about 7/8 of a mile' (-6.9%). OSM supplies only the campus boundary and CEBAF Center.
